business.description: Atlas Cycles (Haryana) Limited is a public limited listed company engaged in manufacturing of bicycles and bicycle components with a track record of more than 70 years and an established brand in Indian and international markets.

products.name: Bicycles
products.note: Segments: Standard/Roadster (~55% of total sales), Fancy (~25%), Kids (~20%). Fancy cycles with features like disc brakes, shockers, alloy wheels and gears driving sales in metro/mini-metro cities.

plants.location: Sahibabad, Uttar Pradesh (Plot No. 55, Site-IV, UPSIDC Industrial Area)
plants.capacity: Working at much below optimum level

outlook.statement: India is the second largest manufacturer of bicycles in the world. Growth in population, health consciousness and socioeconomically sustainable rural development are most important demographic trends promoting bicycle as the obvious choice of transportation in future. Fancy and kids segment will grow at a much faster pace as compared to normal roadster cycles.

risks: Rising input costs (sheets, strips, tyres, tubes, chemicals) governed by external forces including international market trends
Product obsolescence and non-acceptance of models could adversely affect revenue stream and profitability

Unhealthy competition from unorganized sector: small manufacturers with little infrastructure and low overheads supplying bicycles at very low prices, affecting organized sector profitability
Unorganized sector sales volume increasing every year due to price advantage despite lower quality and after-sales service
